amendments.stage: parse (first launch); no predictor, policy or score had run; encoders trained on dynamics frames only (256 x 256, unaffected)
amendments.change: the Physion testing HDF5s store 512 x 512 frames (dynamics and readout: 256 x 256); the frozen definition is a 256 x 256 parser input, but physion_trial passed the stored frames through, so the parser raised on the first testing trial (typed shape error, all four parse workers). Fix: testing frames are resized to 256 x 256 with the PIL box filter, and the segmentation presence threshold (16 pixels at 256 x 256) is scaled to the stored area; testing labels are re-derived. The runner gains the amendment registry (load_plan accepts module hashes chained from the frozen ones) and lists amendments in summary.json. CLEVRER parse outputs written before the failure are kept.

amendments.stage: after score and the first publish; frozen records, tokens and readouts unchanged
amendments.change: EXPLORATORY readout mode `explore` added (post-hoc, no disposition): the frozen CLEVRER QA readout sat at its floor (max gated micro contact value 0.051 < threshold 0.5 on every validation video; parsed max-over-frames existence admits 362 phantom objects vs 1911 real in 400 videos, so 38 % of choices are unresolvable), giving identical decisions for every arm; the Physion predicate rule likewise never fired. The exploratory readout uses a 5-frame existence rule and thresholds fitted on the training (CLEVRER) / readout (Physion) split. slot_attributes gains min_frames (default 1 = frozen behaviour); findings.md gains label-free tables, parser fidelity and the exploratory section.

amendments.stage: after publication (phase-B/C review); no training, no score, no record changed
amendments.change: digest repair, validation hardening and reporting. (1) The frozen Physion static digest serialized the object-dtype model_names field as object pointers, so G1's frozen zero full-parameter-set overlap was not a content check; the digest now hashes canonical contents (strings as UTF-8, integers int64, floats float64; key, type and shape delimited), and mode leakage-audit re-derives G1 on the frozen membership from the retained HDF5s (leakage-audit.json, regenerated by --validate); G1 reads it. (2) The audit also reports the physical overlap with the appearance-only colour excluded and the trajectory distance of every testing / fitting pair that shares it (DESCRIPTIVE); findings.md and summary.json qualify the Physion results accordingly. (3) load_plan verifies data_manifest_sha256 and accepts module drift only through scripts/post_freeze_amendments.py, which now lists A1-A3 (the module entries above are this file's disclosure record and no longer authorize). (4) A2's phrase 'identical decisions for every arm' is inexact: the frozen CLEVRER J - J-cont is -0.0000546 and Physion J / J-cont readout accuracies are 0.517 / 0.539; no arm shows a >= delta downstream advantage and CLEVRER sits at the frozen readout floor.
